title: Vickie G NDE 21970
content: ‘Bring your son into the examining room, the doctor will be there shortly’ the young nurse instructed. As I took my two-year old son by the hand, I walked into the stark white room where I sat in a chair and held him in my lap. He was resting his head against my chest. He had complained of a sore throat, and I could tell he wasn’t feeling well because he had become lethargic and wasn’t as active as he normally was. Within a few minutes, the doctor came into the room assisted by the nurse. He asked, ‘What brings you into the office today?’ I replied, ‘He’s had a little bit of a fever, a sore throat, and has just lost most of his energy’. The doctor then said, ‘Well, let’s take a look at you young man’. He then sat my son upon the examining table and had him open his mouth so that he could check his throat. ‘Red throat’. He then took the end of his stethoscope and listened to David’s chest while he told him ‘Breath a deep breath and hold it now, okay let go’. I had not been aware that I was feeling dizzy or anything while I was standing off to the side of the exam. I felt perfectly normal. The next thing I remember was that I saw myself crumpled onto the floor. I was floating above my own body and the sensation was euphoric, it was a feeling of perfection in the highest form. I was completely weightless and hovering over my own body in complete bliss. I watched and listened suspended above my own body. At the same time, it was as though all questions of the universe had been answered in that one moment. The nurse exclaimed ‘Oh my gosh, doctor, what happened?’ The doctor turned as quickly as the nurse had and was checking me. I could see my lifeless body lying there, the eyes were shut and the face was expressionless. He then said, ‘She is sick too, but she’s been taking care of her family and hasn’t even been aware of her own self’. The doctor then called to the assistant ‘Bring the ammonia inhalant pack’. I thought as I was hovering over watching all this ‘No, please don’t do that, I don’t want to come back from where I am, let me stay here’. The feeling was so good, so weightless, so careless and oblivious to any problems of the world, it was the most peaceful feeling I’ve ever experienced. Suddenly I saw the nurse come into the room and hand the white gauze tiny bullet-like packet to the doctor. He snapped it open and the sensation in that split second was that I was being sucked back into my body. The heaviness and confinement of my body came back and I was back in my body in an instant. I never told the doctor of the experience for fear he would think I was insane. At that time, 1971, I had never heard of an ‘out of body’ experience.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Returned after the doctor used an ammonia inhalant pack to revive her.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapsed/fainted in a doctor's office while bringing her sick child for an exam; doctor stated she was sick too.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Sudden return to body when ammonia inhalant was used.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience consisted mainly of an out-of-body observation phase followed by an abrupt return; no tunnel, light, beings, or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported that 'all questions of the universe had been answered in that one moment' while hovering above her body.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating above my own body and the sensation was euphoric, it was a feeling of perfection in the highest form.” / “At the same time, it was as though all questions of the universe had been answered in that one moment.” / “the sensation in that split second was that I was being sucked back into my body.”
